text:
sahil: Deploy bot kicked off v2.3.1 canary for geo-fanout. Starting slices: US (5%), EU (0%) until US is green, APAC queued. quick capacity check please?
deploy-bot: kickoff accepted. slice=us weight=5% image=redwood/infer:v2.3.1 pid=deploy-2400001111
ana: tagging in @ops-oncall — can we confirm reserved pool headroom in US-West and EU-West? also note version pin in the rollout plan.
ops-oncall: US-West GPU pool current util=68%, reserved=20% (headroom=12%). EU-West util=55%, reserved=15% (headroom=30%). APAC util=72%, reserved=10% (headroom=18%).
jin: thanks. ops: that US headroom is a bit tight for a broad ramp. recommend keeping canary at 5% for 20m and run a transient load test (qps + burst) before gating EU.
sahil: ack. plan: run synthetic spike at t+5m targeting US canary pods. target qps=3k sustained for 2m. if p95 < 700ms and errors < 0.5% we open EU to 3%.
marta: adding rollout guard: rollback if error_rate >= 2% for 5m OR p95 > 900ms for 3m. Also a hard-cap: if GPU eviction events > 1 in 10m, rollback immediately.
jin: adding cost/throughput pin: EU will be pinned to quantized variant model-q2 if CPU memory pressure spikes beyond 85%. That variant matches v2.3.1 output checks.
ops-oncall: quick cmds I ran:
```
# check pool sizes
kubectl -n infra get nodes -l pool=gpu-us-west -o wide
# sample metric
promql: avg_over_time(node_gpu_utilization[5m])
```
US GPU nodes = 12 (vgpu slots=96), avg util=68%.
ana: release notes link: https://redwood-internal/release/v2.3.1 — includes improved KV-cache batching and small headroom saving change. QA verified deterministic outputs on our regression set.
sahil: good. one more safety: enable model fallback route in smart router config: on model-inference-oom switch to model-v2.3.0-quant. That should avoid hard errors.
deploy-bot: EU slice queued. will start EU slice at weight=3% when operator /sahil approves.
ops-oncall: running synthetic spike now against US slice. will post results in ~3m.
(3m later)
ops-oncall: synthetic results: peak qps 3.1k, sustained 2.9k, p50=85ms, p95=640ms, errors=0.23%, GPU evictions=0. No thermal throttles. :thumbsup:
marta: looks good. we have 12% headroom still in US. approve EU start.
sahil: /approve — EU start now. deploy-bot, start EU slice.
deploy-bot: EU slice started weight=3% image=redwood/infer:v2.3.1
jin: note: EU autoscaler targets set to min=6 nodes during rollout for cushion. watch the autoscale events for spikes in scale latency.
ops-oncall: EU warmup shows avg util 52% on canary nodes. running a short traffic drift test (routing 10% of canary traffic to EU nodes) to validate latencies from EU users.
ana: APAC still queued. we should not open APAC until EU is stable for 15m and cumulative error budget < 0.7%.
marta: maintenance window note: we have a scheduled infra patch in APAC tomorrow 03:00 local — avoid cutting APAC heavy traffic into that window.
(15m after EU start)
ops-oncall: EU status after 15m: p95=710ms, errors=0.44%, GPU evictions=0. No anomalies. cumulative (US+EU) error rate=0.35%.
jin: looks safe. APAC go-ahead if we want smaller weight to start: APAC 2% then 6% over 20m.
sahil: start APAC at 2%. keep monitor thresholds same. ops-oncall, kick synthetic smoke from APAC edge to validate cold starts.
deploy-bot: APAC slice started weight=2% image=redwood/infer:v2.3.1
ops-oncall: APAC smoke: p95=820ms (cold starts), p50=110ms, errors=0.6% (transient). warming caches — expect p95 to settle under 750ms in 10m.
marta: accept transient but keep eyes on p95 trend. if APAC p95 doesn't drop below 800ms within 12m, trigger canary rollback for APAC slice.
sahil: decision notes for runbook: 
- Rollback trigger: error_rate >= 2% for 5m OR p95 > 900ms for 3m OR GPU_evictions>1/10m
- Soft degrade: if p95 between 750-900ms for >12m, reduce weight by 50% and re-evaluate.
- Fallback model: model-v2.3.0-quant
- Pin behavior: EU pinned to model-q2 if mem pressure >85% during ramp.
ana: I've appended these to the release notes and notified CS. also flagged the APAC infra patch to the schedule owners to avoid interference.
ops-oncall: all slices currently: US=5%, EU=3%, APAC=2%. metrics are green. will keep rolling logs and update if any threshold crosses.
jin: post-mortem action item: add a synthetic canary that mimics high-concurrency prefix scenarios to catch kv-cache cold paths next time.
sahil: thanks everyone. leaving the rollout to auto-progress + manual gating. I will escalate if any rollback triggers. :rocket:
deploy-bot: rollout progressing. next auto-step at t+45m to bump weights US->20%, EU->10%, APAC->8% unless manual hold or rollback detected.
marta: noted. tagging @oncall-sre for overnight watch once we hit broader ramp.
(reacted with :eyes: by jin)
